exposure: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) status (with or without)
Type of cesarean section (emergency vs. elective)
outcome: Bladder injury (length, degree, time of occurrence)
cohort: The study included all pregnancies complicated by bladder injury during cesarean delivery at a tertiary hospital between January 2018 and December 2023.
finding: Longer and more severe bladder injuries are seen in patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), and the risk of bladder injury is higher in emergency cesarean sections regardless of PAS status.
mod_finding: The risk of bladder injury is higher in emergency cesarean sections compared to elective cases, irrespective of placenta accreta spectrum status.
